The scores from the paths suggest a moderate level of confidence in this relationship, though the exact mechanism remains to be elucidated. The evidence supports a potential role for Belotecan in the treatment of these tumors, but further research is needed to confirm the specific mechanism of action and to establish its clinical utility.
